metadata.title: Every hyperbolic knot has an arc-faithful closed braid diagram
metadata.abstract: Every hyperbolic knot admits an arc-faithful closed braid diagram, answering Conjecture 29 of McPhail-Snyder. More precisely, any braid representing the knot can be reworded in the same braid group so that the complete holonomy has distinct incoming parabolic fixed points at every crossing. The construction replaces a pinched crossing by five non-pinched crossings when a suitable third strand is adjacent. On $n$ strands it uses at most $2n-1$ letters per replaced crossing. The resulting diagram realizes the complete holonomy by nondegenerate shapes in its four-term octahedral decomposition.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.progressType: 双曲结的弧忠实闭辫图
analysis.workSummary: 作者证明每个双曲结都承认弧忠实闭辫图。可在同一辫群中重写任意给定表示，使完备 holonomy 在每个交叉处的两个入射抛物不动点不同。
analysis.breakthrough: 有适当相邻第三股时，将一个被夹挤交叉改成五个非夹挤交叉。在 n 股上，每个替换的交叉至多需 2n−1 个字母。所得图以非退化形状实现完备 holonomy，回答 McPhail-Snyder 猜想 29。
analysis.limitations: 结须双曲。字长界按被替换交叉计，五交叉局部构造保留第三股条件。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
analysis.aiEvidence: 第6页 Tool Use 明确 OpenAI Codex 协助发展与检查证明、查找文献、准备 LaTeX 稿和 TikZ 辫图。记证明、核查、文献和写作排版四项用途。
